candidate.title: Inverted cancellation guard prevents CancelToken from ever cancelling

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/spread.js:26 wraps arr in an extra array via callback.apply(null, [arr]), so apply receives [[1,2,3]] and invokes the callback with the whole array as its single argument instead of spreading its elements.

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/combineURLs.js:22 returns baseURL.slice(0, end) + relativeURL.replace(/^\/+/, '') with no '/' separator, while helpers/combineURLs.js:18-20 strips trailing slashes, so 'http://a/b' + 'c' yields 'http://a/bc'.

candidate.claim: cookies.read splits on '; ' only, so a cookie string serialized with bare ';' (no space) is not split and cookies after the first separator are missed.

verifier.reason: Confirmed: helpers/cookies.js:48 splits only on '; ' and helpers/cookies.js:51-52 compares only the text before the first '=' in each piece, so a bare-';' string like 'a=1;b=2' remains one piece and lookup for 'b' returns null.
